card.name: Linking words before radiation or regression terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, during, of, for, including) and the end of 'stereotactic' in drug-label text, where a term like radiation, radiosurgery or regression is likely to come next.

modes.label: Prepositions before next term
modes.description: A short linking word such as in, during, at, for or of where the next word could be radiation or regression related.
modes.example: Discontinuation of corticosteroids may result<< in>> clinical improvement of Kaposi’s sar

modes.label: Inside 'stereotactic'
modes.description: The ending of 'stereotactic' just before radiosurgery.
modes.example: Cancer patients who receive stereot<<actic>> radiosurgery (SRS) and whole

card.writes: It pushes the model toward radi- words (radiation, radio) and regression, and away from unrelated words like leaf or bell.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words when the text is about to mention radiation or regression.
